title.value: The Secret to Better AI and Better Software (is Requirements Engineering)
title.justification: The paper emphasizes the role of requirements engineering as a crucial aspect for enhancing AI and software development.
title.quote: Researchers in requirements engineering think so, arguing that requirement engineering is the secret weapon for better AI and better software.

extractions.description: The paper explores the integration of AI and requirements engineering (RE), examining how RE can enhance AI and software development. It discusses the importance of contextual understanding and the role of AI in optimizing requirements engineering processes, particularly in safety-critical systems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on software engineering and the integration of AI with requirements engineering rather than directly addressing climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Much has been written about the algorithmic role that AI plays for automation in SE. But what about the role of AI, augmented by human knowledge? Can we make a profound advance by combining human and artificial intelligence?

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any direct themes related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
primary_category.quote: Much has been written about the algorithmic role that AI plays for automation in SE. But what about the role of AI, augmented by human knowledge?

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary themes related to climate or ecological sustainable development are present.
secondary_categories.quote: One concern with this “keep it simple” approach is that some fear that such simpler models will perform worse than more complex options.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories of climate or ecological sustainable development do not align with the focal points of requirements engineering and AI integration discussed in this paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: AI for RE during deployment: When we deploy software into the cloud, there is a need for automated “requirements agents” that can negotiate the appropriate access to shared resources.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The secondary sub-categories do not relate to the main topics of combining AI and requirements engineering discussed in this paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: This technology is particularly exciting for requirements engineering since decades of research has resulted in optimization and theorem proving algorithms that scale to very large models.

applications.justification: There are no direct applications of climate or ecological sustainable development discussed within this paper.
applications.quote: If we add more requirements into AI, and use RE methods to get truly desired requirements, can we make better software by combining human and artificial intelligence?

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories do not capture the focus of the paper on AI and requirements engineering.
new_primary_category.quote: Researchers in requirements engineering think so, arguing that requirement engineering is the secret weapon for better AI and better software.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no need for a new sub-category as the paper does not address climate or ecological sustainable development topics directly.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Safety critical systems must be understandable and auditable by humans... The more an AI tool understands human requirements, and human reasoning, the more they can produce simpler and more explicable models.
